# Inter

Inter 4.1 by The Inter Project Authors (https://github.com/rsms/inter), SIL Open Font License
1.1 (`LICENSE.txt`). `Inter-Regular.ttf` and `Inter-SemiBold.ttf` are copied unmodified from
`extras/ttf/` of the release archive `Inter-4.1.zip`
(sha256 `9883fdd4a49d4fb66bd8177ba6625ef9a64aa45899767dde3d36aa425756b11e`). The launcher
embeds them in its binary (`tools/embed_files.py`); `LICENSE.txt` ships next to it.
